verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an identity platform with its own automation surface (Actions and no-code Forms), so scheduled jobs or workflows are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, only shows Actions as flow-triggered Node.js functions that customize login and identity flows, with no recurring or cron-style scheduling. The CLI's 'automate tasks' wording would require a user-side external scheduler, which earns no credit.
